title: Knives (skill)

infobox.Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Knives.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Knives is a skill related to Knives weapon class.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Higher skill level in knives reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

sections.heading: Leveling up
sections.text: The player gains 1.5 experience per one-handed and 1 experience per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.

full_text:
Knives (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Knives.

Introduction. Knives is a skill related to Knives weapon class.

Effects. Higher skill level in knives reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

Leveling up. The player gains 1.5 experience per one-handed and 1 experience per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.
